title: Drawing on the Powers of Heaven: Mental Exertion and Mind Control
summary: This final installment on Grant von Harrison's book focuses on the necessity of mental exertion to unlock divine power. Highlighting teachings from Joseph Smith, Brigham Young, and Spencer W. Kimball, the message underscores that faith requires intensive discipline over one's thoughts rather than passive daydreaming or anxiety. By intentionally visualizing righteous goals, tracking daily thought patterns, and casting out doubt, individuals can completely alter their physical circumstances and build an unshakeable connection to the powers of heaven.
